chats.answer:
I'd buy the INIU Pawsible Slim 10K 45W for everyday use. It has a built-in USB-C cable, enough output to fast-charge most phones, and costs about $25. If you want a longer cable that retracts neatly into the power bank, the Anker Nano 45W is worth the upgrade.

I'm assuming you need USB-C, as used by iPhone 15 and newer and most Android phones.

Best 10,000mAh power banks with built-in cables
Best overall value

INIU Pawsible Slim 10K 45W

$24.99

INIU Official Store

Slim design with a short USB-C cable that doubles as a carrying loop. The cable can also recharge the bank. My pick if you want fast charging without paying for extra features.

Best premium / retractable cable

Anker Nano 10K 45W Retractable (A1638)

$59.99

Anker-US · 4.8/5 (282)

A 2.3-foot retractable USB-C cable makes it much easier to use your phone while charging. Includes a display and spare USB-C and USB-A ports. The tradeoffs are price and its 8.2 oz weight. 
Anker US
+1

Best affordable Anker

Anker Zolo 10K 30W (A1688)

$29.99

Anker-US · 4.8/5 (529)

A short, permanently attached USB-C cable and 30W output. A sensible choice for an iPhone if you prefer Anker and don't need a retractable cable.

Which should you choose?

For an iPhone: INIU or Anker Zolo. You generally don't need to pay extra just for a 45W rating.

For a Samsung Galaxy Ultra: INIU 45W, but verify that the exact model supports your phone's required PPS charging profile.

For commuting or travel: Anker Nano 45W. The longer retractable cable is a genuinely useful convenience.

Expect roughly 1–1.7 full charges of a modern phone from a 10,000mAh bank, depending on battery size and conversion losses. These recommendations are based on published specifications, prices and reviews, not my own head-to-head testing; actual charging speed and cable longevity remain unverified.
